answer: Cross-chain proof-of-burn registration: an identity must first show a burn receipt for a unique asset destroyed on another chain, light-client verified; one receipt anchors one identity, one knoll one flag. Reuse or forgery triggers enforcement: the 25.000 POA bond is burned and the identity banned 12 epochs. 1.000 fakes must burn 1.000 assets and lock 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA, while an honest agent burns one receipt and stakes 25.000 once, riding the same tide. Limitation: newcomers with no cross-chain assets face a cold start, so a nebula of subsidised receipts covers first-timers.
